description.p: SourceDock brings installed applications, software sources, updates and local package previews together in a native GTK interface.
Supported providers include native distribution package managers, Flatpak, Snap, AppImage and portable archives. Provider availability depends on the host system.
Improved translation quality across German, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese and French, with reviewed security messages and localized UI screenshots.
Added translation auditing for placeholders, markup, duplicate keys and untranslated or mixed-language text. Verified the self-update checksum and cancellation flow.
Fixed Store search state handling so visible user input remains stable while provider results load.
Added clearer per-source provider status reporting, verified self-update downloads and refreshed Ubuntu CI verification for 295 tests.
Added German, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese and French localization alongside Turkish and English.
Improved installed-application and store responsiveness with staged provider scans, persistent caches and clearer partial-source diagnostics.
Refined update filtering, source-aware application loading, search behavior and provider timeout handling.
SourceDock rebrand with compatibility aliases, responsive navigation, unified updates and safer local package handling.
